title: The agentic web is here
hook_text: The agentic web is finally here.
script:
In two thousand one, Tim Berners-Lee published a vision for the Semantic Web in Scientific American.
He outlined an internet designed to be navigated by autonomous software agents to address our every need.
Now, Artificial Intelligence is making that twenty-five-year-old prediction a reality across the modern internet.
MIT Technology Review reports that autonomous software is finally taking over digital navigation.
This shift replaces manual browsing with systems executing complex online tasks for users.
Would you let an AI agent manage your digital life entirely on its own?
